## B27 audit: limited selected record

The supplied record contains one functional summary, not the underlying program, teacher, candidate-acceptance records, or complete archive. The archive is `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/Documents/Codex/2026-11-02/scene-rsi-rsi-1-3d-blender/work/scene_archive/bundles/smoke.tar.gz`; the supplied member is `experiments/scene_rsi_pilot/smoke/smoke_01/functional/summary.json` (characters [0,360)).

**Observed result and rule.** The summary identifies the target as `curved faucet` and reports `structure_pass: false`, `material_pass: true`, `composite_required: true`, `composite_pass: true`, and `functional_pass: false` (same member, keys as quoted, characters [0,360)). Its `interpretation` describes the evaluation as “Structural/edit operability only” and says an expected composite being absent counts as failure, never N/A. This states an evaluation rule; the supplied record does not show the underlying checks or establish why structure failed or how the overall result was computed.

**Limits of the evidence.** `semantic_object_completeness` and `support_collision_truth` are both `null` (same member and range). Consequently, this record does not establish multi-object coverage, physical contact or collision truth. The material pass is a reported check, not evidence of a particular texture or visual appearance. No supplied detail establishes part connections, pose, camera, lighting, or render quality.

The record reports a structural/edit-operability failure alongside a material pass, but does not provide enough detail to classify the cause as technical versus visual-quality failure. It contains no identifiable teacher problem detection, diagnostic hypothesis, proposed H/M or code update, student mechanism execution, or candidate acceptance. Nor does it substantiate any candidate-acceptance rule beyond the stated functional interpretation. No unseen execution or image appearance can be inferred from this summary.
